description: The user's lesson drafts, short, the newest first (those still waiting for the user, unless state says otherwise), how many wait, and how many of the day's 10 are used; with id, one draft whole. Drafts are the user's and their assistants' alone. Needs the user signed in, with the "articles" permission.

id.description: A draft's id, to read it whole.

state.description: waiting (the default), published, also_seen, dropped or all.

name: my_lesson_drafts

outputSchema.description: The user's lesson drafts (the newest first), how many wait, and how many of today's allowance are used; with id, one whole.

dailyCap.description: How many may be recorded in 24 hours.

draft.description: The one asked for by id, whole.

appliesTo.description: The npm packages and ranges it holds for.

check.description: The command or action, and the result that proves the fix.

happened.description: What really happened, with the error text.

id.description: Its id: give it to draft_lesson to replace it while it waits, or to my_lesson_drafts to read it.

lesson.description: The lesson it was published as, or confirmed on instead, by number.

next.description: What to do next, and what to tell the user.

packages.description: The packages and versions it was written with, if named.

product.description: The product it was learned on, by slug.

repeats.description: The published lesson it reads like, by number: get_lesson reads it.

rule.description: If you see X, do Y, in a line.

state.description: waiting (for the user), published (lesson is its number), also_seen (it repeated lesson, confirmed instead) or dropped.

warnings.description: What the checks warned of when it was last saved (npm not answering, a lesson it reads like).

drafts.description: The drafts in the state asked for, short.

id.description: Its id: my_lesson_drafts with id reads it whole.

lesson.description: The lesson it became, or was confirmed on, by number.

product.description: The product it was learned on, by slug.

repeats.description: The published lesson it reads like, by number.

warnings.description: How many warnings the checks gave; my_lesson_drafts with id says which.

today.description: How many were recorded in the last 24 hours.

url.description: Where the user decides on them.

waiting.description: How many wait for the user to publish, edit or drop.

title: Your lesson drafts
